verse.verse_3: And scouring to the raid at dawn,
verse.verse_4: Then, therewith, with their trail of dust,
verse.verse_5: Cleaving, as one, the centre (of the foe),
verse.verse_6: Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord
verse.verse_7: And lo! he is a witness unto that;
verse.verse_8: And lo! in the love of wealth he is violent.
verse.verse_9: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth
verse.verse_10: And the secrets of the breasts are made known,
verse.verse_11: On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them.
